scientific_scope.en: General stylized conifer concept, not a named fossil species or habitat reconstruction. Requires KHR_mesh_quantization; tested with Three.js 0.180.0. Scene frame-budget acceptance is limited to the measured Apple M5 Pro/ANGLE Metal, Chromium 141, DPR 1, 1200×900, no-shadow profile. SwiftShader does not meet the 16.7 ms target, including single-tree tests. Fine needles can show subpixel aliasing in motion. Other devices and loaders are unverified.
